meta.captured_ideal: Test files define a detailed and runnable set of test cases needed to ensure easy verification that a script works.
meta.struct_description: This document defines the rules, prompts, and descriptions of for '*_test.json' files. Each test file is expected to meet the required testing format and coverage standards required by the repository.
meta.category_description: Test .json files are used to create detailed and executable test cases for each script within the repository.

base_audit.test_folder: Each script should have its own dedicated folder inside its respective FILETYPE directory whose name is its own.
base_audit.file_format: All test files must be a parsable .json file.
base_audit.test_plan: Each script's test folder must contain a single 'test_plan.json' file.
base_audit.test_plan_keys: The 'test_plan.json' file must use the same dictionary keys as the [test_plan] dictionary inside of test_plan_template.json
base_audit.test_plan_values: The 'test_plan.json' file must use the same value types for each key as the [test_plan] dictionary inside of test_plan_template.json
base_audit.test_keys: All test case files must use the same dictionary keys as the [test_case] dictionary inside of test_case_template.json.
base_audit.test_values: All test case files must use the same value types for each key as the [test_case] dictionary inside of test_case_template.json
base_audit.code_coverage_minimum: All 'test_plan.json' files must have an integer value in their [code_coverage] key greater than 85.
base_audit.passing_percentage: All 'test_plan.json' files must have an integer value in their [passing_percentage] key greater than 99.
base_audit.ran_last: All 'test_plan.json' files must have a datecode string in [ran_last] that correctly marks the last time the full test plan was ran.
base_audit.functional_coverage: All 'test_plan.json' files must have at minimum one [functional] value filled out.
base_audit.exception_coverage: All 'test_plan.json' files must have at minimum one [exception] value filled out.
base_audit.mock_files_test_plan: All files listed in the [files] list of any test case .json file must be present in the tests directory.
base_audit.mock_files_folder: All files other than 'test_plan.json' and '*_test.json' in the test directory must be listed in [test_files] of 'test_plan.json'.
base_audit.literal_string_flag: All dot-separated paths that should not be parsed as actual dot-separated paths must start with '!STR_LITERAL!'.
base_audit.python_test_files: All python files in the test directory must end with '_test.py'.
base_audit.test_case_files: All test case names must end with '*_tests'.
base_audit.integration_test_cases: All integration tests must execute a minimum of two consecutive functions in their test_steps_order list.
base_audit.full_test_cases: All full test test_steps_order fields must be composed of consecutive functions that are at minimum two integration test's test_steps_order entries.
base_audit.support_files: Test support files must never be mock python scripts that execute code to help with running the test cases.
base_audit.support_files_python: All test support files that are python files must only ever be used as input data or output comparison for the test definitions.
